# Puzzle Challenge Hub

> Puzzle Challenge Hub is an online casual puzzle game platform providing free browser-based games, detailed game walkthroughs, video guides, and categorized puzzle collections ranging from match-3 to logic strategy games.

## Main Navigation Pages

- [Home Page](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/): Primary entry page featuring top daily puzzle games and trending brain teasers.
- [All Games Catalog](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/all-games): Full game index where users can search, discover, and play all online puzzle games.
- [Game Recommendations & Guides](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/recommendation): Original articles, strategy walkthroughs, gameplay introductions, images, and video tutorials for the latest and hottest puzzle games.
- [Game Collections Hub](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/collection): Overview directory of game collections categorized by core mechanics and themes.

## Game Collections by Category

- [Hexa Puzzles](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/collection/hexa): Hexagonal grid placement and block puzzle games.
- [Sort Puzzles](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/collection/sort): Color, liquid, and item sorting logic challenges.
- [Screw Puzzles](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/collection/screw): Mechanical pin, screw unbolting, and nuts-and-bolts puzzle games.
- [Merge Puzzles](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/collection/merge): Item combining, evolution, and merging casual games.
- [Jam Puzzles](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/collection/jam): Unblock, grid escape, and traffic jam style evacuation games.
- [Block Puzzles](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/collection/block): Classic block fitting and line-clearing puzzle games.
- [Mahjong Solitaire](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/collection/mahjong): Traditional and themed Mahjong tile-matching games.
- [Match Puzzles](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/collection/match): Tile matching and match-3 puzzle games.
- [2048 & Number Games](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/collection/2048): Arithmetic, number merging, and math logic puzzles.
- [Tetris Games](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/collection/tetris): Falling block puzzles and classic Arcade Tetris variations.
- [Solitaire Card Games](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/collection/solitaire): Patience card games, Klondike, and puzzle solitaire.

## Optional & Index

- [XML Sitemap](https://puzzlechallengehub.com/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable XML sitemap indexing all site content.
